_about: Items. `art` is the item's sprite (art/sprites/item_<id>.png, drawn by tools/item_art.py); `icon` is a GameIcon name (Storyleaf/UI/GameIcon.swift) used when there's no art; weapons are drawn in the hero's hand from their art (or icon). Armour `sheets` (per race) swaps in a whole walk sheet while it's worn (Retro Diffusion art in art/sprites; only the skin colour applies), recoloured by `tint` for the rare colour variants bosses drop. `bareHead` (true) marks sheets with their head cut off (tools/wear_art.py BARE_HEADED): the hero's own head, beard and hair are drawn over them, as the hat slot is what goes on the head. What an armour drew on the head (a helmet, hood, coif or wizard's hat) is a hat of its own, the armour's `headpiece`: type head with `headgear` (the kind of sheet whose cut-off head it is, art/sprites/hat_<kind>_<race>.png, recoloured by its `tint`; or `hood`, a hide cloak's hood, art/sprites/hood_<body>.png, painted in its `color` and `accent`, lined with fur for `pattern` fur), of the armour's level, classes and tier, a quarter of its stats and price, and had wherever the armour is (tools/check_content.py checks). Armour `pattern` adds finer detail to the sprite (engraved | scales | fur | runes | pockets). Armour `recolor` changes the outfit colours while worn and `wear` its cut on the hero's sprite (vest | mail | plate | robe | cloak), drawn by Storyleaf/Art/GearOverlay.swift. `accent` (#RRGGBB) is the trim colour on the sprite, or a necklace's chain. `color` (#RRGGBB) is how gloves, boots and a necklace look worn (on the hands, the feet and under the chin), or a cape's colour. `tier` puts armour in a RuneScape-style tier: one level and one colour for a whole set (a fighter's plate, a mage's robe, a tamer's hide cloak, gauntlets and boots), so the colour tells the level; tools/item_art.py draws their icons from `color`. `glow` (#RRGGBB) gives a magic weapon a soft light at `glowAt` ([x, y] in its 32×32 art): a halo in the icon (tools/item_art.py) and a gentle pulse while held. type: consumable | weapon | armor | head (hats: festive ones with `hat`, an armour's with `headgear`) | gloves | necklace | boots | accessory (rings, charms and bands) | material | cape. A hat's `hat` is which piece it is on the hero's head (art/sprites/wear_<hat>.png, cut out of Retro Diffusion art by tools/wear_art.py and fitted by GearOverlay.hat): crown (a party crown), santa, ears (a bunny's, its band in `accent`) or mask, in its `color`. A necklace with `wear` scarf is a festive scarf instead (art/sprites/wear_scarf.png in its `color`, under the chin); only the festive seasons give them (content/rewards.json `seasons`). `classes` limits who can equip it (omit = everyone); `level` is the level needed. Materials (type material; `material` is wood | metal | gem | hide) drop from monsters of at least their `level`; a quest's pieces are `material: quest` (none for sale, never dropped but by the quests that want them, content/quests.json `drops`). `recipe` is what a blacksmith needs to forge the item; one with `make` (carve | join) is made by hand from the bag instead, for a quest that asks you to bring it. Companion toys (`toy`, Fairyland Online's Pet Toys) are consumables given to a companion from the bag: they raise its `stats` for good, up to ten toys a companion (GameSession.giveToy). Seal Stones (`capture`) are thrown in battle to befriend a monster and used up whether they hold or not: `sealPower` is how many times likelier than a plain one a stone is to hold (1 unless set), and a `sure` one (the Wishing Seal) never fails (BattleEngine.captureStatus).

items.name: Monster Book Cape
items.description: For one who has beaten every kind of monster there is: the whole Monster Book, worn on your back.

items.name: Card Collector's Cape
items.description: For one who holds every monster card. It rustles like a well-shuffled deck.

items.name: Quest Cape
items.description: For one who has finished every quest there is. Everyone you ever helped is stitched into it.

items.name: Bossbane Cape
items.description: For one who has beaten every boss. Monsters whisper about whoever wears it.

items.name: Wayfarer's Cape
items.description: For one who has set foot in every land. Its hem still carries a little dust from each.

items.name: Storyleaf Cape
items.description: For one who has earned every other cape. The whole tale, woven into one.

items.name: Beastfriend Cape
items.description: For one who has raised a companion all the way to level 200. Every scratch and nuzzle on the road there is in its weave.

items.name: Starlight Dust
items.description: Glittering dust from a Starmoth's wings. It glows a little brighter in the dark.

items.name: Starfall Shard
items.description: A shard of star-glass a Crystal Quill dug up. It hums, very softly.

items.name: Star Lantern
items.description: A lantern of star-glass with Starlight Dust glowing inside. It never needs lighting.

items.name: Glimmerwing Boots
items.description: Stitched from wings the Starmoths shed. You land more softly than you jumped.

items.name: Starweave Robe
items.description: Woven in Glimmerbough from moonflower silk. At night, tiny stars drift across it.

items.name: Starweave Hat
items.description: A wizard's hat, to wear with the robe of the same name.

items.name: Starpetal Gauntlets
items.description: Silver gauntlets set with crystal petals from Pip's garden. They chime when you make a fist.

items.name: Stargazer's Band
items.description: Stargazer Lune's thank-you: a band of night-blue silver. Look through it, and the stars come closer.

items.name: Fallen Star Pendant
items.description: A sliver of the Fallen Star, given gladly. It's warm, and it hums when you're far from home.

items.name: Starfall Staff
items.description: Its tip holds a spark the Fallen Star left behind.

items.name: Starfall Blade
items.description: Forged in starlight. It leaves a trail of sparks.

items.name: Starfall Axe
items.description: Its edge glitters like a falling star.

items.name: Starfall Whip
items.description: It cracks like a shooting star, and beasts follow its light.

items.name: Seed Pouch
items.description: A little sack of seeds, slightly chewed. A hamster's idea of a packed lunch.

items.name: Honeybee Charm
items.description: Barnaby carved it from honeycomb wax, and Rosie dusted it with flour for luck. It smells of clover.

items.name: Stray Sock
items.description: A striped woollen sock with a few spiny holes in it. Its partner is still out there somewhere.

items.name: Windstep Sandals
items.description: Bryn laced them with kite string. On a windy day you hardly touch the ground.

items.name: Silver Fish
items.description: A fat silver herring with eagle talon marks. Still fresh, more or less.

items.name: Glow Shell
items.description: A Wood Crab's spare shell. It glows a soft sea-green when the sun goes down.

items.name: Shell Lantern
items.description: Three Glow Shells on a little frame of White Poplar. Bright enough to guide a boat home.

items.name: Tidecaller Pendant
items.description: Marla's mother wore it on the boats. Hold it to your ear and the sea talks back.

items.name: Gold Nugget
items.description: A lump of real gold, still a little sticky. Goldie will want it washed first.

items.name: Prospector's Gloves
items.description: Thick leather gloves with brass knuckles, slime-proof and goo-proof. Mostly.

items.name: Beetle Shell
items.description: A Dark Beetle's wing case. Polish it and it glows a deep violet.

items.name: Owl-Eye Amulet
items.description: A round amber stone that sees in the dark. Fenwick swears it blinks.

items.name: Crisp Apple
items.description: A shiny red apple with one small monkey bite. Monkeys have good taste.

items.name: Forest Truffle
items.description: A knobbly brown truffle that smells of earth, rain and hog.

items.name: Orchard Gloves
items.description: Moss's picking gloves, soft as moss and green as leaves. Apples just drop into them.

items.name: Sugar Crystal
items.description: A pink crystal of pure sugar, only a little licked.

items.name: Rock Candy Crown
items.description: A crown of pink rock candy with an Amber jewel. Please don't eat it before the Gala.

items.name: Peppermint Boots
items.description: Red and white like a peppermint stick, and they leave a minty smell wherever you walk.

items.name: Healing Mud
items.description: A warm dollop of swamp mud. It smells awful and works wonders.

items.name: Bogwalker Boots
items.description: Tall waders that never leak. Ida swears by them, and at them, now and then.

items.name: Honey Muffin
items.description: A golden honey muffin, a bit squashed. Grandmother will still eat it.

items.name: Red Hood Ribbon
items.description: A ribbon from Little Red's cape. Wolves think twice when they see it.

items.name: Wisp Silk
items.description: A skein of thread spun from a Wisp's glow. It's warm, and it hums very softly.

items.name: Swan Lace Veil
items.description: A veil of glowing lace with an Emerald clasp, light as a swan's feather.

items.name: Swan Feather Brooch
items.description: A white swan's feather pinned with silver. Odette sent it over with the ferry, without a word.

items.name: Bull Horn
items.description: A curved horn, polished smooth. Shaved thin, it lets candlelight through like amber.

items.name: Bell Clapper
items.description: The iron tongue of Candlewick's bell. A monkey has been chewing it.

items.name: Bell-Ringer's Gloves
items.description: Rope-worn gloves with brass bells on the cuffs. They ring when you fight.

items.name: Snake Scale
items.description: A brown scale as hard as iron and as smooth as a pebble.

items.name: Ratcatcher's Boots
items.description: Scaled boots that no rat can bite through. Bodkin made a pair for you, and three for himself.

items.name: Dew Pearl
items.description: A dewdrop as round as a pearl. It never dries up, and it tastes of morning.

items.name: Lotus Lantern
items.description: A tiny lantern of dew pearls on a bamboo stick. It floats.

items.name: Lotus Dew Charm
items.description: A pink lotus bud with a dew pearl at its heart. The tiny folk say it brings gentle luck.

items.name: Golden String
items.description: A puppet's golden string. It still twitches now and then, out of habit.

items.name: Heartwood Locket
items.description: A locket carved from the heart of the puppet tree, with a tiny puppet inside. It waves.

items.name: Sun Quill
items.description: A Light Hedgehog's quill, still glowing like a sunbeam.

items.name: Genie's Lamp
items.description: A gold oil lamp with three Sun Quills for a wick. Rub it, if you dare.

items.name: Genie's Ring
items.description: When the lamp lit, a puff of blue smoke left this ring on Kasim's counter. No wishes, sadly.

items.name: Raw Ore
items.description: A lump of ore, still sticky with lizard. Bruna doesn't mind.

items.name: Forgehand Gauntlets
items.description: Bruna forged them in her own fire. They stay warm on the coldest morning.

items.name: Rough Gem
items.description: An uncut gem, cloudy and lumpy. Iolanthe can see a shape in it already.

items.name: Prism Lamp
items.description: A lamp of cut gems round a Diamond heart. Light it, and rainbows spill everywhere.

items.name: Prism Pendant
items.description: A prism Iolanthe cut from the lamp's last gem. It throws tiny rainbows wherever you go.

items.name: Coffee Beans
items.description: A handful of dark roasted beans. One sniff and you'll be up till Tuesday.

items.name: Sweet Dream
items.description: A good dream in a little glass jar, glowing like a night light. Shh.

items.name: Dozy Slippers
items.description: Fluffy slippers so soft you could fall asleep standing. You won't, though. You'll just walk very quietly.

items.name: Frost Apple
items.description: A rosy apple with a crust of frost. Perfectly safe. Perfectly delicious.

items.name: Seven Hearths Ring
items.description: Seven tiny gems, one from each dwarf. Warm as a fireside, even in the snow.

items.name: Moon Rice
items.description: A little sack of rice so white it glows by moonlight. Perfect for mochi.

items.name: Mochi Tray
items.description: Round white mochi stacked on a bamboo tray, the first for the Moon Rabbit Queen.

items.name: Moon Rabbit Charm
items.description: A silver rabbit sitting in a crescent moon. Selene says the Queen herself sent it down.

items.name: Lion's Mane
items.description: A tawny tuft of an Earth Lion's mane, thick and a little dusty.

items.name: Great Drum
items.description: A big drum trimmed with lion's mane. Beat it once and the steppe answers.

items.name: Steppe-Runner Boots
items.description: Soft hide boots for running through grass taller than you. They never stumble.

items.name: Fire Pepper
items.description: A shiny red pepper so hot it's warm to hold. Achoo.

items.name: Sneezing Powder
items.description: A bamboo pot of red powder. Don't open it indoors. Don't open it at all, really.

items.name: Pepperfire Gauntlets
items.description: Red gauntlets with pepper-shaped studs. Your punches come with a little heat.

items.name: Frozen Jelly
items.description: A frozen chunk of Temple Jelly. It still wobbles a little, somehow.

items.name: Clear Ice
items.description: A block of ice so clear you can read through it. A Snowman was keeping it.

items.name: Ice Swan
items.description: A swan carved out of clear ice, wings half open. It might fly off if you look away.

items.name: Frostlight Pendant
items.description: A drop of lake ice that never melts, with a lantern's light caught inside.

items.name: Jelly Pearl
items.description: A soft-glowing pearl from a Temple Jelly's middle. It smells faintly of the sea.

items.name: Offering Shell
items.description: A white shell holding four pearls, one of them a dragon's. The tide will like it.

items.name: Tidesong Ring
items.description: A ring of sea-green silver. Hold it to your ear, and the tide sings.

items.name: Crystal Silk
items.description: A skein of silk as clear as glass and stronger than steel. It whispers when it moves.

items.name: Crystal-Silk Gloves
items.description: Woven from Crystal Widow silk by Arachne herself. Light as air, tough as steel.

items.name: Cloud Glass
items.description: A drop of golden glass rained by a Golden Cloud. Perfectly round, perfectly clear.

items.name: Emerald Spectacles
items.description: Round spectacles with green glass. Through them, the whole world is emerald.

items.name: Emerald Glass Amulet
items.description: Fennimore's best lens, set in gold. Look through it and you'll see the city past the gate.

items.name: Glimmerstone
items.description: A lump of geode from the Glimmerdeep, glowing softly from the inside. A lantern could burn on it for a hundred years.

items.name: Sealed Letter
items.description: A letter sealed with green wax. Rosie says it's private, which means it's about cake.

items.name: Mayor's Reply
items.description: A rolled letter tied with a red ribbon, the city's gold seal on it.

items.name: Jar of Honey
items.description: Barnaby's best clover honey, the lid tied down tight. The bees counted every drop.

items.name: Flask of Lantern Oil
items.description: Fenwick's own lantern oil. It glows a little in the dark, all by itself.

items.name: Everlasting Wick
items.description: A candle with a blue flame that never burns it down. Mabbott's finest.

items.name: Flask of Well Water
items.description: Clear, cold water from Samira's well, for Mungo to have a look at.

items.name: Herbal Tonic
items.description: Mungo's green tonic for thirsty camels. It smells of swamp and works like magic.

items.name: Sack of Coffee
items.description: Bastian's darkest roast. Enough to keep seven dwarfs awake through a whole winter.

items.name: Dwarf-Forged Kettle
items.description: A round copper kettle the dwarfs hammered out for Bastian. It boils in a blink.

items.name: Ice Rose
items.description: A rose carved out of clear ice. It never melts, but it's cold enough to make you sneeze.

items.name: Prismscale Mail
items.description: Scales the Prism Drake shed in its sleep, laced into mail. In the dark it glows like the Glimmerdeep.

items.name: Prismscale Helm
items.description: A helm, to wear with the armour of the same name.

items.name: Goldleaf Plate
items.description: Ivory plate edged with gold leaf from Meadowbrook's oldest oak. Only a hero at the very top can wear it.

items.name: Goldleaf Helm
items.description: A helm, to wear with the armour of the same name.

items.name: Goldleaf Robe
items.description: White silk stitched with gold leaf from Meadowbrook's oldest oak, for a mage at the top of the world.

items.name: Goldleaf Hat
items.description: A wizard's hat, to wear with the robe of the same name.

items.name: Goldleaf Gauntlets
items.description: Ivory gauntlets with a gold leaf on the back of each hand. What you hold, you hold for good.

items.name: Goldleaf Boots
items.description: They've walked every road there is. A gold leaf at each heel, like a little wing.

items.name: Goldleaf Pendant
items.description: A single gold leaf from Meadowbrook's oldest oak. It never wilts.

items.name: Goldleaf Ring
items.description: A gold band with a leaf curled round it, still green at the tip. Elder Oak's thank-you for the long climb.

items.name: Goldleaf Blade
items.description: A long ivory blade with two gold leaves for a guard, given only to heroes at the top.

items.name: Goldleaf Axe
items.description: An ivory crescent on a handle of heart-oak. It cuts as clean as the first frost.

items.name: Goldleaf Staff
items.description: Heartwood from Meadowbrook's oldest oak, crowned with gold leaves round a light that never dims.

items.name: Goldleaf Whip
items.description: A lash of braided gold with a leaf at its tip. Beasts follow it as leaves follow the wind.

items.name: Red Party Hat
items.description: A red paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: Yellow Party Hat
items.description: A yellow paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: Green Party Hat
items.description: A green paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: Blue Party Hat
items.description: A blue paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: Purple Party Hat
items.description: A purple paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: White Party Hat
items.description: A white paper crown for the New Year party. Rare in every colour; can you find all six?

items.name: Green Halloween Mask
items.description: A green mask with a ghoulish grin. Monsters can't tell whether to fight you or flee.

items.name: Blue Halloween Mask
items.description: A blue mask with a ghoulish grin. Monsters can't tell whether to fight you or flee.

items.name: Red Halloween Mask
items.description: A red mask with a ghoulish grin. Monsters can't tell whether to fight you or flee.

items.name: Santa Hat
items.description: Red and white, with a pom on the end that bobs as you walk. Ho ho ho!

items.name: Red Christmas Scarf
items.description: Red and white stripes, wound twice round and still long enough to flap in the wind.

items.name: Green Christmas Scarf
items.description: Holly green and snow white, knitted by someone who clearly loves you.

items.name: Bunny Ears
items.description: Soft white ears for Easter, pink inside. They twitch when you're happy.

items.name: Pumpkin Pie
items.description: Halloween's treat, still warm from the oven. Restores 100 HP and 30 MP.

items.name: Gingerbread Man
items.description: Christmas's treat, iced with a smile. Restores 100 HP and 30 MP.

items.name: Party Cake
items.description: A slice of New Year cake, all sprinkles. Restores 100 HP and 30 MP.

items.name: Chocolate Egg
items.description: Easter's treat, wrapped in coloured foil. Restores 100 HP and 30 MP.
